args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The round_money function was using ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring
and the test suite (tests/test_money.py) expecting banker's rounding
(ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212. This caused the nightly build failures.

Switch the import and quantize rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so
halfway amounts round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66,
2.675 -> 2.68).

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py::round_money` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but its docstring and `tests/test_money.py` require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212. This mismatch was failing the nightly build.
- Switched the decimal import and `quantize` rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Behavior
- Halfway amounts now round to the nearest even cent, e.g.:
  - `2.675 -> 2.68` (last kept digit already even)
  - `2.665 -> 2.66` (rounds down to even)

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
